title: I made super clawd boy , because the anthropic mascot always reminds me of super meat boy!
author: conall88
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/bav1t4u3bkrh1.png?width=1845&format=png&auto=webp&s=5d2744b015b2e75c641fc660023ff9e8d98094a9

You can play it here: [https://superclawdboy.conall.org/](https://superclawdboy.conall.org/) 

the source code is here if you'd like to clone it and play with it:  
[https://github.com/conall88/super-clawd-boy](https://github.com/conall88/super-clawd-boy)

if you get stuck you can press H to have a ghost give you a hint.

This was made with opus 5.5, via cursor in a matter of a few hours.

I've been enjoying other people's posts, so figure I should share this too.

I look forward to seeing what other people cook up on these models, they seem much better than previous iterations for gamedev in particular.

My next miniproject is going to be an ARPG in the vein of path of exile / diablo 2. This one is probably going to be more involved. if it gets to a quality I think is share worthy, i'l make sure to post about it.
